chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: O God, I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And by Ali ibn Abi Talib, and Hasan, and Husayn, and the Imams from them, that You send prayer upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And accept from me my prayer, my fasting, my supplication, my remembrance, my glorification, my declaration of oneness, and my takbir.
And make me among the highest of 'Illiyin.

key_terms.تَسْبِيحِي: My saying 'Subhan Allah' (Glory be to God)
key_terms.تَكْبِيرِي: My saying 'Allahu Akbar' (God is the Greatest)
key_terms.تَهْلِيلِي: My saying 'La ilaha illa Allah' (There is no god but God)
key_terms.عِلِّيِّينَ: A high rank or realm of the righteous in Paradise

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of invoking the Imams in Shia supplications?
ai.summary: This du'a, recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din*, exemplifies the Shia theological emphasis on *tawassul* (seeking intercession through the spiritual authority (haqq) of the Ahl al-Bayt to attain divine acceptance. It reflects the tradition of Imam al-Sadiq’s teachings, linking the purity of the Prophet’s household to the believer’s elevation among the *al-afidin* (the righteous) in the highest celestial realms.
